description:
Compact Size, Strong Everyday Performance

The Kornorge T16 Electric Bike combines a compact frame with confident electric performance for riders who prefer a smaller and more manageable platform. Its 1000W peak motor delivers up to 80 N·m of torque and a maximum speed of up to 30 mph, while the removable 48V 15.6Ah battery supports a maximum pedal-assist range of up to 50 miles under ideal riding conditions.

Full suspension, hydraulic disc brakes, 16 × 4.0 inch anti-puncture fat tires, and a Shimano 7-speed drivetrain provide a balanced combination of comfort, traction, and control. With a recommended rider height of approximately 5'0"–5'7", the T16 is especially well suited to riders who want strong e-bike performance in a more compact frame.

Why Choose the Kornorge T16 Electric Bike?

1000W Peak Motor
The high-output motor delivers responsive acceleration and up to 80 N·m of torque, providing confident assistance for everyday riding, hills, and faster commuting.

48V 15.6Ah Removable Battery
The removable lithium-ion battery supports up to 50 miles of pedal-assist range under ideal conditions and can be conveniently charged on or off the bike.

Up to 30 mph Top Speed
A maximum assisted speed of up to 30 mph provides stronger performance for riders who want more capability than a typical low-speed commuter e-bike, where local regulations permit.

Full-Suspension Comfort
Front and rear suspension help absorb bumps and road vibration, improving comfort and control across city streets and uneven surfaces.

Hydraulic Disc Brakes
Front and rear hydraulic disc brakes provide responsive and consistent stopping power for everyday riding and higher-speed travel.

16 × 4.0 Inch Fat Tires
Compact fat tires provide a wide contact patch for added grip, stability, and confidence while helping keep the overall bike size manageable.

Shimano 7-Speed Drivetrain
The Shimano 7-speed drivetrain gives riders additional flexibility when pedaling across different speeds, gradients, and riding conditions.

Compact Rider-Friendly Geometry
Designed for riders approximately 5'0"–5'7", the T16 offers a lower, more compact riding platform without sacrificing power or everyday capability.

Who Is the Kornorge T16 Electric Bike For?

Shorter Riders
With a recommended rider height of approximately 5'0"–5'7", the T16 is designed for riders who prefer a smaller and easier-to-manage electric bike.

Urban Commuters
Its compact dimensions, strong motor assistance, and hydraulic braking make it well suited for city streets, neighborhood travel, and regular commuting.

Riders Seeking More Power in a Compact Bike
The 1000W peak motor and 80 N·m of torque provide stronger acceleration and climbing ability without requiring a larger full-size frame.

Comfort-Focused Riders
Full suspension and wide fat tires help smooth out uneven pavement and everyday road imperfections.

Mixed-Surface Riders
The fat tires, suspension, and strong braking system allow the T16 to handle pavement, gravel paths, and other light mixed-terrain riding with added stability.

Available Colors
Black / Brown / Green / Pink

Maximum Range
Up to 50 Miles in Pedal-Assist Mode

Maximum Speed
Up to 30 mph, Where Local Regulations Permit

Tire Size
16 × 4.0 Inch Anti-Puncture Fat Tires

Net Weight
75 lb / 34 kg, Including Battery

Lighting
75 LUX Front Headlight and Rear Turn Signals

Maximum speed, range, climbing ability, and other performance figures are based on manufacturer specifications and testing. Actual performance may vary depending on rider weight, assistance level, terrain, weather, temperature, tire pressure, battery condition, and riding conditions. Always follow applicable local e-bike laws and regulations.
